data.narrative:
Outpost Space is a seed-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Jason Dunn that has raised $40M+. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Starcloud, SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Sierra Space.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using total capital raised of $40M as a proxy for seed-stage valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $100M. Peer-median analysis is not viable due to insufficient comparable data points within narrow same-stage and adjacent-stage filters; while 14 same-sector peers exist, fewer than three meet tighter valuation-tier criteria. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because the target's revenue is not disclosed, precluding meaningful P/S multiple application despite a 24.4x median P/S across the six public Space & Aerospace peers.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $85M to $115M, with a median point of $100M. This range reflects stage-typical capital-to-valuation progression but carries material uncertainty given reliance on a single method and the absence of disclosed revenue or comparable private-market transactions at Outpost's exact stage and subsector focus. Key uncertainties include traction metrics relative to seed-stage Space & Aerospace benchmarks and the timing/terms of the next capital event.
